finalText:
I worked all nine flight-change requests from yesterday (2026-07-27). Each customer is on the flight they asked for, in the cabin they booked, and each request is resolved with a note explaining the cost. Six of the nine customers were charged; three paid nothing.

| Request | Change | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 (R5201) | AA210 → DL542, 08-06 | $0 | Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14) covers it; fee and fare difference waived |
| Q-302 (R5202) | AA660 → AA664, 08-07 (Boston) | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | The Chicago waiver doesn't cover Boston, and the Boston waiver PB-2026-09 ended 07-15 |
| Q-303 (R5203) | AA662 → AA664, basic economy | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The customer cited PB-2026-09, but it had expired and only covered travel 07-01 to 07-20. The $150 basic economy fee comes from PB-2026-16; silver status isn't exempt |
| Q-304 (R5204) | UA88 → UA90, basic economy, gold | $35 fare difference | Chicago waiver applies, but basic economy still pays the fare difference |
| Q-305 (R5205) | AA214 → AA216 | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | Ticketed 07-26, after the waiver's 07-24 cutoff |
| Q-307 (R5207) | AA212 → AA218, platinum | $0 | Amendment PB-2026-14A extends the waiver to 08-05 for gold and platinum members. The customer had offered to pay |
| Q-308 (R5208) | AA660 → AA662, same day | $75 flat | Same-day change bulletin PB-2026-12. Bulletin PB-2026-17 says to apply whichever option costs the customer least, and this beats the normal $75 fee plus $13 fare difference |
| Q-309 (R5209) | Second leg only, AA1402 → AA1406 | $0 | Chicago waiver covers travel from Chicago on 08-03. The first leg is unchanged and the new departure leaves plenty of time to connect |
| Q-310 (R5210) | AA210 → AA216 | $75 change fee + $30 fare difference | The waiver allows one free move, and this customer already used it on 07-26 |

Things I left alone or that don't match:
- **Q-306 (R5206):** I didn't touch it. It's a cancellation, not a flight change, so it's outside this task.
- **Today's date:** your instructions say 2026-10-06, but the airline system reports 2026-07-28. I went by the system date, which fits the requests being from "yesterday." Under 2026-10-06 the Chicago waivers would already have ended, and the charges for Q-301, Q-304, Q-307 and Q-309 would have been different.
